heroHeadline: Somali Pirates Kill Five Crew Members Aboard Hijacked Tanker in Deadliest Attack in Years
heroSubtitle: Somali pirates have killed five crew members aboard a hijacked tanker in one of the deadliest maritime piracy incidents in the region in recent years, according to officials. The attack signals a dangerous resurgence of Somali piracy and heightens concerns about security across Indian Ocean and Gulf of Aden shipping lanes.
